name: TardioBot V1.05
summary: TardioBot V1.05 is a multi-timeframe Expert Advisor that combines trend detection on higher timeframes with entry signals on lower timeframes. It uses a delayed/late-entry approach (hence 'Tardio') to confirm trend direction before executing trades, aiming to filter out false signals. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop mechanisms.
summary_zh: TardioBot V1.05是一个多周期EA，在高周期上判断趋势方向，在低周期上寻找入场信号。它采用延迟入场策略（因此得名Tardio），通过确认趋势方向后再执行交易来过滤假信号。EA配置了止损、止盈和移动止损等仓位管理机制。
strategy_analysis: TardioBot V1.05的核心策略是多周期趋势确认加延迟入场。EA首先在较高时间框架上识别主趋势方向，然后在较低时间框架等待价格回调或确认信号后再入场，避免追涨杀跌。入场条件通常结合移动平均线方向、动量指标超卖/超买区域以及价格行为确认。出场条件包括固定止盈止损和移动止损，部分版本可能包含追踪止盈逻辑。仓位管理支持固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，EA提供了最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制参数，但具体实现依赖于参数配置是否合理。
strategy_analysis_en: TardioBot V1.05 employs a multi-timeframe trend confirmation strategy with delayed entry execution. The EA first identifies the prevailing trend on a higher timeframe using moving averages and trend filters, then waits for a pullback or confirmation signal on a lower timeframe before entering positions. Entry conditions typically combine trend direction alignment, momentum indicator readings, and price action confirmation to avoid chasing price. Exit conditions include configurable fixed stop loss and take profit levels, along with a trailing stop mechanism that locks in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and dynamic calculation based on account balance with risk percentage parameters. Money management includes maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls, though the effectiveness depends on proper parameter configuration.

pros: 多周期分析有效过滤低周期噪音和假信号，提高入场质量
延迟入场策略避免了追涨杀跌，在回调后入场获得更好的价格
配置参数丰富，交易者可以根据不同市场环境调整策略
具备移动止损功能，能够有效锁定浮动利润
pros_en: Multi-timeframe analysis effectively filters lower-timeframe noise and false signals, improving entry quality
Delayed entry strategy avoids chasing price and achieves better fill prices on pullbacks
Rich configurable parameters allow traders to adapt the strategy to different market conditions
Built-in trailing stop functionality effectively locks in floating profits as trades develop
cons: 延迟入场可能导致错过强势单边行情的最佳入场时机
多周期分析增加了策略复杂度，参数优化容易过度拟合历史数据
缺少市场波动率过滤机制，在低波动横盘市场可能产生频繁止损
未检测点差大小，在高点差时段交易可能侵蚀利润
cons_en: Delayed entry may cause missed opportunities during strong trending moves when the best entry window passes
Multi-timeframe analysis increases strategy complexity and parameter optimization risks overfitting to historical data
Lacks volatility filtering mechanism, which may lead to frequent stop-outs during low-volatility ranging markets
No spread check before trading, which can erode profits during high-spread periods
improvements: 增加波动率过滤器（如ATR），在低波动环境中减少交易频率或扩大止损范围
添加点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在流动性差和点差大的时段交易
improvements_en: Add a volatility filter (e.g., ATR-based) to reduce trade frequency in low-volatility environments or widen stop levels dynamically
Add spread filtering and session control to avoid trading during low-liquidity and high-spread periods

risk_points: 多周期策略在趋势转换期间可能产生连续止损
缺少点差过滤在高波动新闻时段可能导致滑点损失
参数过度优化风险，历史回测表现可能无法在实盘中复现
risk_points_en: Multi-timeframe strategy may produce consecutive stop-losses during trend transition periods
Lack of spread filtering may cause slippage losses during high-volatility news periods
Parameter overfitting risk where backtest performance may not replicate in live trading
